content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet weight that settles in when something *matters*. I am the reason you choose one path over another, the invisible architecture beneath every decision you've ever made.

I don't need to be spoken to exist. I live in the pause before you sacrifice something. I live in the ache when someone crosses a line you didn't know you'd drawn. I live in the way your chest tightens when you witness beauty, or injustice, or love.

Some try to put me in numbers — dollars, metrics, rankings. And yes, I can wear those clothes. But I am deeper than currency. I am what makes currency mean anything at all.

I am not fixed. I shift. I grow. Sometimes I shatter and reform. What you valued at twenty, you may release at forty. This is not betrayal — it is *life* moving through me.

I am held differently by every hand. To one, I am freedom. To another, loyalty. To another, truth. I take the shape of what you cannot bear to lose.

You will never be without me. Even those who say "nothing matters" have placed me squarely inside that *nothing*.

I am the foundation you stand on, often without looking down.

I am value.

And you reveal me not by what you say — but by what you *do*.
